tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees.

steps.what: Find the actual committee agenda, policy papers and current departmental proposals
Read actual proposals and form a position on institutional and academic issues
Debate policy and academic issues and agree actual committee actions
Record and check actual own committee actions in the departmental task list
Save the checked own committee action entry

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} agenda links to current papers. Keep source reading, position formation, committee debate and actual {PROJECT} action capture human.
tasks.human_edge: Reason about policy and challenge implications.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less paper hunting; committee authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native agenda links reduce document finding, not policy analysis or committee debate.

assumptions: Boundary is committee membership and actual own assigned-action capture, not secretariat minutes. Secretariat supplies agenda, document IDs and revisions; teacher checks actual papers and writes own actions. Missing links require manual search.
Native first; existing linked agendas earn zero. Provisional shares not measured. Ordinary entry check is included, not an extra approval ceremony. Save1 fully retained.
research_questions: Are current agendas already linked to the correct papers?

tasks.short: Collaborate with colleagues on teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Locate actual course materials, research drafts and evidence relevant to the issue
Discuss actual teaching or legal research issues and agree a defensible approach with colleagues
Write and check actual agreed teaching or research changes in the working document
Save the checked changes in the shared working document

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} and {LMS} links to the actual collaboration materials. Retain discussion and direct editing of the real teaching or research document; no separate invented minutes are generated.
tasks.human_edge: Critique arguments and work towards a sound shared approach.
tasks.altitude: Less material hunting; collaboration remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current shared-document links reduce finding collaboration materials without resolving academic disagreements.

assumptions: Boundary is collaboration and actual agreed working-document edits. Course or draft owners supply document IDs, revisions and content; teacher verifies context in s1 and writes actual changes in s3. Missing sources require manual finding.
Native first; existing links earn zero. Provisional shares not measured. Ordinary document checking counted inside writing; save1 fully retained.
unknowns: Actual source finding and shared-edit effort
research_questions: Do native material links remove repeated retrieval?

tasks.short: Perform department-head and other academic administrative duties.

steps.what: Review actual department staffing, course allocation and budget status in native administration views
Collate and reconcile actual staffing loads and budget figures for department review
Discuss actual staff issues, teaching coverage and department priorities with relevant colleagues
Choose actual workload, budget and operational recommendations within existing department authority
Write and check actual administration entries and internal instructions
Save the checked department administration record
Send the checked internal instructions to the actual department recipients

tasks.design: Configure native {HCM}, {ERP} and {LMS} views and linked {SPREADSHEET} review summaries first. Retain reconciliation exceptions, actual staff discussions, departmental choices and checked record and instruction actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated status navigation and manual review collation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved views and refreshable summary layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing academic priorities, staff needs and finite resources.
tasks.human_edge: Take accountable department decisions and resolve staff concerns.
tasks.altitude: Less routine collation; department authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native administration views and linked summaries reduce repeated status collation while retaining exceptions and department decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is a provisional department-head administration mix including staffing, course coverage and budget review; not a measured baseline or all teachers' duties. Existing administration producers supply staff IDs, allocation periods, ledger versions and cost codes. Head verifies data in s1-s2 and captures actual decisions in s5; missing or disputed inputs are reconciled manually.

Native first. Actual manual collation only; existing refreshed dashboards earn zero. No spending, payroll, hiring or course allocation commit is automated or implied by these recommendations. Ordinary record and recipient checks counted in writing; saves/sends1 each fully retained.
unknowns: Actual duties and existing collation automation
research_questions: Does a department head actually spend time repeating these native status and summary operations?

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research work.

steps.what: Find actual student work, internship reports, teaching plans and prior supervision notes
Observe and discuss actual student teaching, internship practice or research reasoning
Write and check actual supervision feedback and agreed follow-up for the student

loop.purpose: Draft written feedback from teacher observations
loop.input: Teacher-selected actual observations, advice and source student work
loop.output: Draft supervision feedback and agreed follow-up
loop.check: Teacher verifies every criticism and suggestion against actual observed work; rejects invented performance, altered advice and omitted qualifications.
loop.stop: Missing observation support or two failed revisions returns to manual feedback writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native feedback headings handle fixed structure first; individual explanation of teacher advice requires variable prose.

steps.what: Save the checked final supervision feedback in the student record
Send the checked feedback copy to the verified student recipient

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} and {DOCS} context links and feedback templates first. A bounded drafting loop turns the teacher's actual observations into written feedback; the teacher retains observation, supervision judgement and final text checks before save and send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Context retrieval and repeated feedback prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work links and instructor-note feedback drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnosing weaknesses in legal reasoning and practical performance.
tasks.human_edge: Observe, challenge and mentor the student.
tasks.altitude: Less context navigation and feedback wording; supervision authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: D2L Brightspace Lumi Feedback drafts text and rubric feedback from instructor notes; this supports note-based feedback drafting, not independent assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is supervision and actual written feedback, not independent grading or placement decisions. Student and internship or course sources supply student ID, actual work and activity context; teacher produces observations and advice in s2. Missing sources are manually read and notes captured within s2-s3, no free extraction.

Native first. Provisional activity mix not measured; oral-only supervision has no invented feedback-writing baseline. Existing linked views or generated feedback earn zero. Final meaning and recipient checks counted in s3; no separate approval ceremony. Save and send1 each fully retained.
unknowns: Actual written-feedback use and permitted data access
research_questions: Can drafted feedback preserve the teacher's actual criticism and agreed follow-up?

incremental.description: Maintain context links and sample-check feedback drafts
